youtube_title: Wrong Electricity Bill? They Can't Cut Your Power If You Do This | Rules You Didn't Know #26 #Shorts
youtube_description:
RULES YOU DIDN'T KNOW #26. Bill 5x higher plus a disconnection notice. Pay it all, or is there another way? Comment A or B!
Answer: B. Electricity Act 2003, Section 56: if you dispute the bill, deposit under protest either the amount claimed or a monthly charge at your average of the last 6 months, whichever is less. Then supply can't be cut while the dispute is pending, and any cut needs 15 clear days' written notice. Complain to your discom, then the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum (CGRF), then the Electricity Ombudsman.
Source: Electricity Act 2003, Sections 56 and 42.
